title: German Venison Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from the German countryside, featuring tender venison in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the venison cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the venison from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the reconstituted dasima, red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Return the venison to the pot and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the venison is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
